description: Submit raw PRD/plan/spec text plus a list of target repos; Codemind LLM-decomposes it into stories (each assigned to one of your declared repos, never an invented one) and dispatches them via the same path build_batch uses. Pass dryRun: true to see the decomposed story list without dispatching anything, useful for reviewing before committing. Recommended for a first-time caller: review with dryRun: true, then resubmit the (possibly edited) story list via build_batch directly — a second build_from_spec call with dryRun: false re-decomposes specText from scratch and will not reflect edits made to a prior dry run's output.

deliver.description: Opt in to delivery: when every story has finished, open one pull request per target repo (a draft if any story did not verify or the repo's own tests newly fail). Needs the repo attached through the GitHub App; an unattached repo is reported with nextAction attach_repo and its files stay available from get_build_files. Never merged automatically. Results appear under deliveries in get_batch.

existingFiles.description: OPTIONAL current contents of this repo's files that the spec changes or depends on ({path, content}). With deliver and the repo attached through the GitHub App you can omit this: Ship reads the files each story names, plus their local imports, from the repo itself. Every story for this repo is built with them (a file whose path the story names is edited, the rest are read-only context). With deliver, Ship only overwrites an existing file that is supplied here AND still has exactly this content in the repo at delivery; any other existing file is never overwritten.

name: build_from_spec
